ward.summary: Goregaon (ward P/S) used ₹43.5 lakh of its ₹48.0 lakh budget, 91%, and stayed within budget across 82 jobs. About 21% of repairs were redone within 30 days, against 23% expected, so durability is in line with expectations; ₹3.4 lakh went on repairs that failed. Seven jobs are listed for review, and 14 jobs worth ₹5.0 lakh were paid on roads under warranty. Next, the ward should address 18 open issues costing ₹3.7 lakh, starting with waterlogging on Link Road and MG Road Goregaon. The remaining ₹4.5 lakh covers all of them.
